## Church & Dwight Announces Strategic Investment in BALI CURLS™ and BALI GENTS™


November 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/233583214/files/doc_news/Church--Dwight-Announces-Strategic-Investment-in-BALI-CURLS-and-BALI-GENTS-2026.pdf)


EWING, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Church & Dwight Co., Inc. (NYSE: CHD) has signed a definitive agreement to acquire 45% of the shares of BALI Treatment GmbH, a rapidly growing hair care and styling company in Europe that includes the BALI CURLS™ and BALI GENTS™ brands, for approximately $225 million. The brands have established market leading positions in Germany and Austria with expansion across Europe now underway.


The company reported net sales for the twelve months ended October 31, 2026, of approximately $100 million. Church & Dwight will have the option to acquire the remaining 55% of the company’s shares beginning two years after closing, subject to the terms of the agreement.


The Bali Care business was founded in 2022 by Hendrik Genotte to create high-quality hair care and styling products designed around the needs of consumers with curly and textured hair. BALI CURLS™ has built a strong following through clean, vegan and cruelty-free formulations, while BALI GENTS™ extends the company’s consumer-led approach to men’s grooming. The brands combine an authentic, creator-led model with innovative, relevant products that build strong connections with consumers. The company’s leading products include its Hydrating Curl Cream, Curl Defining Gel, Moisturizing Conditioner and Nourishing Shampoo.


Hendrik Genotte, Bali Care Founder, commented “BALI CARE grew from my own experience with curly hair and a desire to create products that help people embrace their natural curls. We are excited to partner with Church & Dwight, whose global capabilities and shared passion for innovation and consumer-focused solutions will help us bring our products and community to even more people around the world.”


Rick Dierker, Chief Executive Officer of Church & Dwight, commented, “Our investment in BALI CARE represents an important step in our strategy to accelerate international growth through high-performing, asset-light consumer brands with strong category leadership. BALI CARE has built distinctive brands with strong consumer loyalty and significant growth potential. With distribution today concentrated in a limited number of European markets, we are poised to leverage Church & Dwight’s global capabilities to expand the brands’ reach and support their next phase of growth.


“The BALI CARE investment squarely fits into our acquisition criteria that focuses on (1) #1 or #2 brand in a category; (2) asset-light; (3) expected to be growth accretive to the Company; and (4) expected to be gross margin accretive to the Company,” said Dierker. “Our strong balance sheet will continue to provide the flexibility to add additional high-quality acquisition and investment opportunities. This capability has been a key driver of Church & Dwight’s consistently strong shareholder returns.”


The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory clearance. The investment is expected to be accretive to cash earnings in 2027, inclusive of acquisition-related expenses and interest expense.


**About Church & Dwight Co., Inc.**


Church & Dwight Co., Inc. (NYSE: CHD) founded in 1846, is the leading U.S. producer of sodium bicarbonate, popularly known as baking soda. The Company manufactures and markets a wide range of personal care, household, and specialty products under recognized brand names such as ARM & HAMMER®, TROJAN®, OXICLEAN®, FIRST RESPONSE®, NAIR®, ORAJEL®, XTRA®, BATISTE®, WATERPIK®, ZICAM®, THERABREATH®, HERO® , TOUCHLAND® and MISS MOUTH’S. For more information, visit the Company’s website.


Church & Dwight has a longstanding heritage of commitment to people and the planet. In the early 1900’s, we began using recycled paperboard for all packaging of household products. Today, virtually all our paperboard packaging is from certified, sustainable sources. In 1970, the ARM & HAMMER™ brand introduced the first nationally distributed, phosphate-free detergent. That same year, Church & Dwight was honored to be one of a few corporate sponsors of the first annual Earth Day. Most recently in 2024 and 2025, our ongoing progress earned continued public recognition, including Time Magazine’s Ranking of the World’s Most Sustainable Companies, Newsweek Magazine’s Americas Most Responsible Companies, USA Today’s Ranking of America’s Climate Leaders, EPA’s Safer Choice Partner of the Year, FTSE4Good Index Series, amongst others. For more information, see the[Church & Dwight 2025 Sustainability Report](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fchurchdwight.com%2Fpdf%2FSustainability%2F2025-Sustainability-Report.pdf&esheet=54641593&newsitemid=20261116607440&lan=en-US&anchor=Church+%26amp%3B+Dwight+2025+Sustainability+Report&index=1&md5=462a9bf66e1ac2e231e5c820e30caf25) on the Company’s website.
